definitions.gloss: serial drama; TV series; ongoing television drama
definitions.explanation: A television drama that airs weekly over a set number of episodes, typically one season (one cour) of 10-12 episodes in Japan. Distinguished from single-episode specials or movies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連続|れんぞく}ドラマ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: This season's TV series are interesting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{月曜|げつよう}→月曜：30298_getsuyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連続|れんぞく}ドラマ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I look forward to the weekly Monday drama series.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連続|れんぞく}ドラマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: That actor has been cast as the lead in a serial drama for the first time.

notes:
A television drama format that runs weekly across multiple episodes, forming the backbone of Japanese prime-time programming. In Japan, dramas typically follow a seasonal pattern (winter, spring, summer, fall) with each season lasting about three months (one cour).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appear in a serial drama
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最終回|さいしゅうかい}→最終回：26891_saishuukai⟧: the final episode of a serial drama
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{視聴率|しちょうりつ}→視聴率：08381_shichouritsu⟧: viewership ratings of a serial drama
- {月|げつ}9⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: Monday 9 PM drama (famous Fuji TV time slot)

FORMS:
Commonly shortened to 連ドラ (れんドラ) in casual speech. This abbreviation is widely used in everyday conversation, entertainment news, and social media.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単発|たんぱつ}→単発：20543_tanpatsu⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: one-off/special drama — a standalone drama broadcast as a single episode
- {朝|あさ}ドラ: morning drama — NHK's serialized 15-minute morning drama (formally ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧)
- ⟦{大河|たいが}→大河：12197_taiga⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: historical drama — NHK's year-long Sunday drama series
